_comment: Bulgarian stress-homograph validation battery + curated seed for lexicon L1b. Each surface form maps to ALL correct stress-marked readings (U+0301 after the stressed vowel) with a gloss. Used to (1) validate lexicon RECALL — the true stress must appear among generated candidates — and (2) seed lexically-distinct homographs that rechko lacks entirely. VETTED pairs only; expand from Bulgarian Wiktionary / a native reviewer before relying on coverage. rechko currently supplies only ONE of each pair (see BG_PARLIAMENT_INGESTION.md).
_vetting: 2026-07-04 native-speaker listening pass on BgTTS battery clips: замък and тела REJECTED as homographs (замъ́к 'lock' is Russian, not standard BG — the Accentor paper itself attributes зàмок/замòк to Russian; тела has only the reading тела́, pl. of тяло — rechko's canonical те́ла is a wrong mobile-stress projection, kept in the candidates DB only for recall). вълна/пара/говори CONFIRMED: two meanings, two stresses, and BgTTS realizes them contextually.

замък.gloss: lock/clasp — Russian, not BG; do not seed

тела.gloss: wires — rejected; тела is unambiguous тела́ (pl. of тяло)
